subject.title: fix(config): reject gateway.port values above TCP port range

question: Should the Doctor migration replace every newly invalid existing `gateway.port` value with `18789`, rather than requiring the operator to choose a replacement port?
rationale: The mechanical validation fix is narrow, but choosing a default port changes the effective value of an existing user setting during recovery and needs owner confirmation of the upgrade contract.

options.title: Accept default-port repair
options.body: Merge the current migration if `18789` is the established safe fallback for malformed or out-of-range gateway ports.

options.title: Require explicit remediation
options.body: Keep the stricter validation but revise Doctor guidance so operators choose a valid port instead of silently receiving the default.

recommendation.title: Accept default-port repair
recommendation.body: Merge the current migration if `18789` is the established safe fallback for malformed or out-of-range gateway ports.

likelyOwner.reason: Most likely adjacent routing candidate for the gateway configuration and default-port recovery contract.
